lines.t: Hey, are you free this afternoon?
Not really. I have a meeting until three. Why?
Do you want to grab a coffee after that?
That sounds good. Which café do you recommend?
The small one across the street. It has a quiet corner.
Nice. What time do you want to meet?
How about three thirty? I can pick you up.
Sounds like a plan. I’ll let you know when I’m ready.
Great. If your meeting runs late, just send me a message.
Will do. See you in a bit. NOTICE: gạch chân từ hỏi, khoanh DO/DOES hoặc BE, rồi nối với câu trả lời.
